title: GitHub Pages Workflow
text:
# GitHub Pages Workflow

How tools get published from an iPad: a repo on [[GitHub]], files uploaded through the website, Pages switched on (main branch /docs, or GitHub Actions), a GitHub Action to rebuild data.

Used by [[Seizure Watch]], [[CITES Timber ID]], [[Precursor Chemical ID]], [[LE OSINT Framework]] and [[Brain Graph]]. Tip: the website's "Add file" creates paths relative to the folder you are in, so check the folder first.

title: PCCP House Style
text:
# PCCP House Style

Shared look for decks, dashboards and bulletins: PCCP (AIRCOP / Container Control Programme) logo banner, Verdana, white background, page number. Used in [[Controlled Deliveries Course]], [[Cultural Heritage Course]], [[Seizure Watch]], [[Precursor Chemical ID]], [[CEN Seizure Risk Board]] and [[CEN Monthly Bulletin]].

Decks: key facts on the slide, full explanation in speaker notes, relevant photos, minimal first slide with banner and page number only.

title: Risk Scoring
text:
# Risk Scoring

Weighted flags rolled into a score and a High, Medium or Low band, with weights as editable numbers.

- [[CEN Seizure Analysis]]: case-level flags such as concealment, multi-country route, controlled delivery and quantity outliers.
- [[Seizure Watch]]: five capped dimensions so seizure weight cannot decide alone, with a "How risk is scored" explanation.
- Also drives the [[CEN Seizure Risk Board]].

title: Controlled Deliveries Course
text:
# Controlled Deliveries Course

Five-day UNODC-WCO Container Control Programme training, four timed sessions per day:

1. Foundations and legal framework
2. Planning, coordination and cooperation
3. Operational techniques
4. Special considerations and legal process
5. Practical application and evaluation

Each session is a standalone PowerPoint with speaker notes in the [[PCCP House Style]]. Sister course: [[Cultural Heritage Course]]. Part of [[Training Courses]].

title: Cultural Heritage Course
text:
# Cultural Heritage Course

Five-day "Cultural Heritage Protection for Law Enforcement" course, four sessions a day (9-4). A PDF overview came first, then all 20 sessions as standalone decks built on the Port Security Icebreaker template ([[PCCP House Style]]). Sister course: [[Controlled Deliveries Course]]. Part of [[Training Courses]].

title: UNODC-WCO Open Source Narcotics Data
text:
# UNODC-WCO Open Source Narcotics Data

2026 workbook of open-source press seizure reports across cocaine, NSA, methamphetamine, cannabis, heroin-opium and cigarettes. Turned into a searchable dashboard in [[CEN Seizure Analysis]]. Similar in spirit to [[Seizure Watch]].

title: WCO CEN nCEN Data
text:
# WCO CEN nCEN Data

Seizure case exports from the WCO Customs Enforcement Network (operation CONTAINERcomm 3). Analysed in [[CEN Seizure Analysis]], scored with [[Risk Scoring]], stored in a private [[GitHub]] repo, summarised monthly in [[CEN Monthly Bulletin]]. [[Seizure Watch]] compares its open-source findings against it.

title: Brain Graph
text:
# Brain Graph

This project: an interactive graph of markdown notes that runs on iPad, published with the [[GitHub Pages Workflow]] from the brain-graph repo on [[GitHub]], built with [[Claude Code]]. The notes you are looking at are its content. Entry point: [[Start Here]].

Possible next step: a J.A.R.V.I.S.-style chat and voice layer.

title: CEN Monthly Bulletin
text:
# CEN Monthly Bulletin

One-page A4 bulletin of the previous month's seizures, produced on the 1st of each month by a scheduled task and saved in the CEN-nCEN-seizure-data [[GitHub]] repo. Data from [[WCO CEN nCEN Data]] via [[CEN Seizure Analysis]]; branded in the [[PCCP House Style]].

title: CEN Seizure Analysis
text:
# CEN Seizure Analysis

Excel and Power BI analysis of [[WCO CEN nCEN Data]] (operation CONTAINERcomm 3).

- Workbook with dashboard, free-text search, risk register and anomaly analysis.
- Case-level risk flags rolled into a score and band: [[Risk Scoring]].
- Country studies: Tunisia, six MENA countries, Sri Lanka, each with a PowerPoint brief or dashboard.
- Quarterly updates; [[Power BI]] free tier, so a single Power Query paste keeps it simple.
- Became the live [[CEN Seizure Risk Board]] and the [[CEN Monthly Bulletin]].
- Exports are stored in a private [[GitHub]] repo (CEN-nCEN-seizure-data).
- Also covers the [[UNODC-WCO Open Source Narcotics Data]] dashboard.

title: CEN Seizure Risk Board
text:
# CEN Seizure Risk Board

Live dashboard artifact built from [[CEN Seizure Analysis]]: a refresh button loads a new Excel export, Power BI-style look, PCCP logo on top ([[PCCP House Style]]), drug-level slicer. Scores cases with [[Risk Scoring]].

title: CITES Timber ID
text:
# CITES Timber ID

Public [[GitHub]] repo to help officers identify CITES-protected wood by genus, species and subspecies, with 10x end-grain photos.

- Searchable species lookup page ([[GitHub Pages Workflow]]), styled like [[Seizure Watch]].
- Current scope: CITES-protected wood in Africa.
- Goal: upload a 10x photo and have AI identify the wood, XyloTron-style.
- Specimens photographed with the [[Dino-Lite Microscope]]; a labelled demo model first, real model once open-source sample images are found.
- Related news category in [[Seizure Watch]].

title: LE OSINT Framework
text:
# LE OSINT Framework

Law-enforcement version of OSINT Framework: a tree of categories with links to free search sources only, in a spider-web style look, shared with colleagues by email. Hosted in the LE-OSINT-Framework repo on [[GitHub]].

Includes a searchable world ports and port-code list and a searchable HS customs code tab. Fits with [[Seizure Watch]] and [[Precursor Chemical ID]] in [[Law Enforcement Tools]].

title: Precursor Chemical ID
text:
# Precursor Chemical ID

Public repo and [[GitHub Pages Workflow]] site: a law-enforcement tool covering drug precursors and other chemicals used in illicit manufacture, including all INCB chemicals.

- Identify a chemical by CAS number or UN number and see what it can be used for.
- Search whether a chemical is produced by the company on the sticker.
- Explains how chemicals are controlled from manufacture to importer, which permits are needed and how to check them.
- Professional look: PCCP logo at top, Verdana, white background with blue, laid out like [[Seizure Watch]] ([[PCCP House Style]]).
- Hazardous chemical news category in [[Seizure Watch]].

title: Seizure Watch
text:
# Seizure Watch

Daily open-source news monitor for illegal drug seizures, with risk analysis for law enforcement officers. Live as a [[GitHub Pages Workflow]] dashboard (repo Seizure-watch-).

- Runs daily on [[GitHub]] Actions and publishes a dashboard.
- Multilingual (Arabic, Turkish, Russian, Chinese, Hindi, Vietnamese for ivory) with automatic translation into English.
- Categories include CITES timber, elephant ivory, protected fauna and hazardous chemicals (see [[CITES Timber ID]], [[Precursor Chemical ID]]).
- Risk score uses capped dimensions so seizure weight cannot decide alone: [[Risk Scoring]].
- Views counted with [[GoatCounter]].
- Daily 10am top-10 bulletin and Monday weekly routes report in the [[PCCP House Style]].
- Score was tested against [[WCO CEN nCEN Data]] via [[CEN Seizure Analysis]].

Its look is the model for other dashboards.

title: Stock Simulation
text:
# Stock Simulation

Paper-money portfolio of EUR 1,000 started 8 October 2026, invested by Claude, with a daily 10am report (Brussels time) from a scheduled task. Interested in trading via the [[Liquid Co-Invest]] connector.

title: Whisky Dashboard
text:
# Whisky Dashboard

YouTube analytics dashboard for [[Whisky Lovers Society]], adapted from the open-source Youtube-Dashboard repo. Private [[GitHub]] repo whisky-dashboard, deployed on Render (free plan) from an iPad, with a YouTube Data API key from Google Cloud.

title: Whisky Lovers Society
text:
# Whisky Lovers Society

Whisky-review YouTube channel (@whiskyloverssociety), started 2021. The "1000 videos" celebration video tasted 10 whiskies as a thank-you.

- Edited in [[DaVinci Resolve]] on iPad; on the Windows PC the plan is Claude Code with a Resolve MCP bridge ([[Claude Code]]).
- Standing look: colour graded, colourful motion graphics with [[Remotion]], something on screen every 10 seconds, b-roll and photos, plus SEO titles, description and tags.
- Analytics: [[Whisky Dashboard]]. Concept: [[Whisky vs AI]]. Hub: [[Video and Content]].

title: Whisky vs AI
text:
# Whisky vs AI

Video concept for [[Whisky Lovers Society]]: AI predicts tasting notes from a whisky's spec sheet, then the presenter blind-tastes and compares.

title: Start Here
text:
# Start Here

The entry point of the brain. Everything hangs off four hubs:

- [[My Projects]] - every project in one place
- [[Law Enforcement Tools]] - tools and dashboards for officers
- [[Training Courses]] - PCCP training material
- [[Video and Content]] - the YouTube channel and its tooling

Shared building blocks: [[PCCP House Style]], [[Risk Scoring]], [[GitHub Pages Workflow]].

title: Claude Code
text:
# Claude Code

Builds and maintains the projects, including [[Brain Graph]]. Plan for the Windows PC: control [[DaVinci Resolve]] through a Resolve MCP bridge for [[Whisky Lovers Society]].

title: DaVinci Resolve
text:
# DaVinci Resolve

Video editor used for [[Whisky Lovers Society]]: paid version on iPad (version 21), plus the free MCP add-on route for [[Claude Code]] on the Windows PC.

title: Dino-Lite Microscope
text:
# Dino-Lite Microscope

Digital microscope used to photograph confirmed African CITES wood specimens at 10x for [[CITES Timber ID]].

title: GitHub
text:
# GitHub

Hosts nearly every project, usually through the website on iPad Safari. See [[GitHub Pages Workflow]]. Repos include Seizure-watch-, CITES-Timber-ID, Precursor-Chemical-ID, LE-OSINT-Framework, whisky-dashboard, CEN-nCEN-seizure-data and brain-graph.

title: GoatCounter
text:
# GoatCounter

Privacy-friendly view counter on the [[Seizure Watch]] dashboard.

title: Liquid Co-Invest
text:
# Liquid Co-Invest

Connector for Liquid (liquid.trade) linked to Claude. Used around the [[Stock Simulation]]; no real trades without explicit approval.

title: Power BI
text:
# Power BI

Free-tier Desktop used for the quarterly refresh of [[CEN Seizure Analysis]], using one Power Query paste instead of many queries and DAX measures.

title: Remotion
text:
# Remotion

Connected for colourful motion graphics in [[Whisky Lovers Society]] videos, alongside [[DaVinci Resolve]].

title: Law Enforcement Tools
text:
# Law Enforcement Tools

Tools and dashboards built to help officers: [[Seizure Watch]], [[CEN Seizure Analysis]], [[CEN Seizure Risk Board]], [[CITES Timber ID]], [[LE OSINT Framework]], [[Precursor Chemical ID]].

They share one look ([[PCCP House Style]]), one scoring idea ([[Risk Scoring]]) and one way of publishing ([[GitHub Pages Workflow]]).
